title: fix(rest): answer 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND for an unknown resource at the package draft, flow runs and datasource by-name doors
body:
Fixes #25486

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

Six doors answered a request about a resource that does not exist as if it were empty or malformed, while their sibling doors answered `404` for the same name. Each now answers `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` naming the missing resource, in its sibling's words. `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` is an existing standard code; no new code is registered.

| door | before | after | sibling it now matches |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/publish-drafts` (unknown id) | `200 { success: false, outcome: 'nothing_to_publish' }` | `404 "Package 'ID' not found"` | `GET /api/v1/packages/:id` |
| `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/discard-drafts` (unknown id) | `200 { success: true, discardedCount: 0 }` | same `404` | `GET /api/v1/packages/:id` |
| `GET /api/v1/automation/:name/runs` (unknown flow) | `200 { runs: [], hasMore: false }` | `404 "Flow 'NAME' not found"` | `POST /api/v1/automation/:name/trigger` |
| `PATCH /api/v1/datasources/:name` (unknown name) | `400 DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR` | `404 "Datasource 'NAME' not found."` | `GET /api/v1/datasources/:name` |
| `DELETE /api/v1/datasources/:name` (unknown name) | `400 DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR` | same `404` | `GET /api/v1/datasources/:name` |
| `POST /api/v1/datasources/:name/migrate-credential` (unknown name) | `400 DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR` | same `404` | `GET /api/v1/datasources/:name` |

### Where absence is decided, per door

- **Datasource (the card's A1).** The producer is `DatasourceAdminService`: `updateDatasource`, `removeDatasource` and `migrateCredential` threw a plain `Error`. They now throw `datasourceNotFoundError(name)`, which carries `code: 'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND'` and `status: 404` (the same shape as the service's existing `metadataIncompleteError` 503). The route's error renderer (`badRequest` in `admin-routes.ts`) relays that envelope, exactly as it already relayed the 503. The message is unchanged. A code-defined datasource is still refused `400 DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR`. **All four by-name doors of `datasource-admin` are covered** (GET was already right). **Left:** the three `external-datasource` by-name doors (`GET …/remote-tables`, `POST …/test`, `POST …/object-draft`). They are a different service with its own registered refusal code, and the unknown-datasource answer there is a driver-registration fact the service comments on as deliberately not a throw. Not measured here. See Acceptance notes.
- **Runs (A2).** `GET /:name/runs` now asks `flowIsUnknown` (`packages/runtime/src/flow-dispatch-status.ts`) before listing. That is the trigger door's own registry probe and message, reused, not a second check. It is asked before the query is judged, as the trigger door asks it. A service without `getFlow` cannot be asked, so it lists as before.
- **Publish-drafts (A3).** Measured. The registry (`qlService.registry.getPackage`) is the existence authority every package read sibling answers its 404 from. Authored packages are installed into it too (`POST /packages`, `service-package` at boot). The runtime packages domain decides it, so **`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` is untouched** and no #25467 region is near this diff. The 404 is answered only when the protocol's answer was empty (`nothing_to_publish`, nothing un-hidden) and the registry lacks the id. Drafts the protocol holds for such an id are still published, so the only answer that changes is the one that lied. `discard-drafts` is the same door's twin with the same defect. It is fixed in place under os-dev rule 3's bounded exemption: same defect class, same mechanical shape, same file, same gate family.

### Consumers (A4)

`ObjectStackClient.fetch` throws on any non-2xx with the envelope's message, so `packages.publishDrafts`, `packages.discardDrafts` and `automation.listRuns` now reject loudly for an unknown id, with no crash path. No in-repo non-test consumer calls these doors for an id it did not first install or register. The dogfood callers all `POST /packages` first. objectui is not in this session. Suspected consumers for the seat to check: the Studio "Publish app" / "Discard drafts" actions and the flow run-history panel, which may render an empty list on any rejection.

## Pins (whole-repo sweep)

- Flipped, now asserting the new substance: `datasource-admin-service.test.ts`. The three "missing datasource" cases asserted `toThrow(/not found/)`. They now assert `{ code: 'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND', status: 404, message }`. In `envelope.conformance.test.ts`, the "credential-migration failure" row used a not-found message for its 400 case; it now uses a store failure, since an unknown name is no longer that arm.
- New pins, each asserting `status` + `error.code` + the named resource, plus a side-by-side parity case against the sibling door:
  - `service-datasource/src/__tests__/datasource-unknown-name.test.ts`: the real service behind the real routes, all four by-name doors, nothing written, controls (a known datasource patches; a code-defined one is still 400).
  - `runtime/src/domains/automation-runs-unknown-flow.test.ts`: 404 with the store never asked; parity with `POST /:name/trigger` (status, code, message); existence before query; control (existing flow with no runs is 200 `[]`).
  - `runtime/src/domains/packages-draft-doors-unknown-package.test.ts`: both draft doors 404; parity with `GET /packages/:id`; controls (known empty package is 200 at both doors; drafts held for an unregistered id still publish; an un-hidden app is reported, not 404).
- Swept with no hit on the old semantics: `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json` (`integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle` already states "unknown name → 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND"), `packages/qa/dogfood/test/**`, `packages/cli/test/**`, `packages/client/src/**`.

## Verification record

Base `e649c2d91`; `origin/main` `481ac6211` merged in as `7da7e5a59` (head). The 12 incoming commits touch no file in `packages/runtime` or `packages/services/service-datasource`. The dependencies they moved were rebuilt before the post-merge re-run.

- Unit (pre-merge, `8247e6c5b`, through `os-verify-lock.sh`): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: Test Files 442 passed (442), Tests 7045 passed and 19 skipped (7064). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource test`: Test Files 57 passed (57), Tests 975 passed (975).
- Post-merge (`7da7e5a59`): the three new files, the flipped pins and the sibling suites (`automation-runs-query-validation`, `automation-trigger-route-status`, `packages-publish-drafts-response-conformance`, `datasource-admin-service`, `envelope.conformance`). Runtime: 5 files, 98 tests, all passed. Service-datasource: 3 files, 68 tests, all passed. `typecheck` for both packages: exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on every touched file: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 72 families. Each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe, and reconciled with `--ran`: 72 derived, 71 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED. 71 exited 0. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3 because the shallow clone lacked its pinned fixture commit; after a fetch of that commit it exited 0. NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it reads every package's `dist/`, and only the build closure was built here). CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it.
- Ratchet re-run on head `7da7e5a59`: `type-check-coverage`, `type-check-debt`, `durability-log-level`, `cross-package-test-inputs`, `test-source-alias`, `nul-bytes`, `issue-citations`, `doc-authoring`, `adr-0087-registration`, `changeset-no-major`, `empty-changeset`, `error-status-conformance`, `dispatcher-error-vocabulary`, `route-envelope`. All exit 0.
- Ablation, one per changed behaviour, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (wrap mode: anchor count 1 to 0 on disk, blob changed, restored blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). The tests import the subject from `src` by relative path, so no `dist` leg applies.
  - `admin-routes.ts` 404 relay disabled: `datasource-unknown-name.test.ts` Tests 4 failed, 2 passed. PATCH, DELETE, migrate-credential and parity went red; GET and the control stayed green.
  - `automation.ts` runs-door `flowIsUnknown` disabled: `automation-runs-unknown-flow.test.ts` Tests 3 failed, 1 passed. The control stayed green.
  - `packages.ts` `packageIsUnknown` forced false: `packages-draft-doors-unknown-package.test.ts` Tests 3 failed, 3 passed. The three controls stayed green.
- Dogfood battery: n/a. No `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.

## Acceptance notes

- `DELETE /api/v1/automation/:name` for an unknown flow: not measured. It calls `unregisterFlow` and `deleteMetaItem` without an existence probe, so it may answer `200 { deleted: true }`. Same family, different verb. Noted, not fixed.
- The `external-datasource` by-name doors (above): not measured for an unknown name.
- `GET /api/v1/packages/:id/commits` for an unknown id is likely `200 { commits: [] }` (unmeasured). Same family, read door. Noted.
- `PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema.outcome`'s describe says `nothing_to_publish` means "the package had no pending drafts". That is still true at the protocol. The REST door now answers 404 before an unknown package reaches it. No spec text is changed here (`Metadata-protocol: none`).
